text:
ana_sales: GlintAI asked for a compact perf validation for their chat checkout POC. Target: sustain 300 qps, handle short bursts to 800 qps (15-25s), p95 <200ms. They want a 1-page runbook + hosted vs dedicated cost delta.
raj_se: Understood. Do we have sample sizes? tokens per req matter for batching.
marta_perf: They shared a sample set: ~65 tokens prompt, ~145 tokens response => ~210 total. Mix: 70% short chat, 30% longer completions. Model: open-70b quant-8.
raj_se: Test plan (suggested): 1) warmup 5m @30% target; 2) steady 30m @300 qps; 3) burst matrix: 4 bursts at 500/650/800/800 qps, 20s each, 90s apart; 4) cross-AZ fallback: 12m with 10% -> region-b. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, batch size distribution, queue length.
nana_sales: (typo)
marta_perf: Prewarm: push 2k representative prefixes to prime KV cache + 10m low-rate fill to warm kernels. Dedicated: reserve ~10% standby capacity; Hosted: keep 2 warm workers during demo.
raj_se: Loadgen snippet we'll use (wrk):
```
wrk -t14 -c420 -d20s -R800 --script=chat_mix.lua --latency $TARGET
```
Steady-state run uses -R300 for 30m. Include our x-rw-trace header for token accounting.
devops-bot: perf job #599 queued: image build OK.
marta_perf: Sizing note: with KV cache active and efficient batching, 300 sustained qps ~6 A100-equiv GPUs; 800 qps bursts -> keep 9 GPUs or autoscale to 10 briefly. Hosted unit cost ~1.7-2x vs Dedicated for same peak.
li_sec: Security flags: SAML SSO, KMS integration for keys, audit logs 90d. If they want to run with PII need signed DPA + KMS key exchange. For demo corpus Hosted is fine.
nana_sales: Can you sketch a quick monthly cost for 1.1M req/mo (avg 210 tokens/req)? simple ballpark for execs.
devops-bot: perf job #599 completed: results uploaded to secure storage.
marta_perf: Dry-run quick numbers: steady 300 qps -> p95 ~195ms, p99 ~430ms. Burst 800 qps -> p95 spiked ~520ms, p99 ~1.2s. With KV-cache disabled steady p95 increased ~30%. GPU util avg 85% sustained, spikes to 99% in bursts. Charts + CSV in secure link.
raj_se: Ballpark pricing: Hosted inference ~ $4.5k/mo (depends on token pricing & burst billing). Dedicated reserved amortized ~ $3k/mo + ops. We'll produce a tidy appendix for the deck.
marta_perf: We'll also run a quick variant with batch_wait_ms=512 to show lower latency at cost of throughput; include both curves.
li_sec: Action items: 1) ana share final corpus link & confirm DPA path (EOD). 2) devops confirm test cluster & creds (done). 3) marta produce one-pager + slides. 4) li share exact SSO/KMS checklist.
nana_sales: I'll follow up on DPA and calendar. Thanks team :thumbsup:
